title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Bank of New Hampshire Pavilion, Gilford | 2022
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Bank of New Hampshire Pavilion, near Lake Winnipesaukee in Gilford, New Hampshire, USA, on 4 June 2022.

It was the sixth show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2022 tour of North America, which lasted for 30 dates between May and October 2022.

Starr had previously performed at the Bank of New Hampshire Pavilion on 7 August 2001 and 10 June 2016.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
